title: Diplomatic Waves: Taiwan's Subtle APEC Encounter
description: At the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Lima, Taiwan's representative Lin Hsin-i greeted China's President Xi Jinping with a wave but had no further interaction. This highlights tensions between Taipei and Beijing, as Taiwan's government stands firm against China's sovereignty claims.

title: Xi-Biden Dialogue: Navigating U.S.-China Tensions Amid Trump's Transition
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Joe Biden held significant talks during the APEC forum in Lima, focusing on cyber crime, trade, Taiwan, and Russia. With Trump's impending presidency, tensions are on the rise, affecting trade and global power dynamics in the Pacific region.

title: Xi Jinping's Promises Amid U.S.-China Tensions
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping expressed willingness to collaborate with President-elect Donald Trump, focusing on key issues like trade and Taiwan amid concerns on cybercrime and Russia. Xi met outgoing President Joe Biden at the APEC forum to discuss maintaining stable U.S.-China relations, even as tensions escalate over several issues.

title: Biden and Xi's Last Diplomatic Dance: Tensions and Transitions at APEC
description: Joe Biden and Xi Jinping met for the final time under Biden's presidency at the APEC summit in Lima, Peru. They aimed to ease tensions amidst disputes over cybercrime, trade, Taiwan, and Russia. Both leaders emphasized maintaining stable U.S.-China relations during the transition to Donald Trump's administration.

title: Biden's Final Face-Off with Xi: Navigating Turbulent Sino-U.S. Waters
description: Joe Biden met Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC forum in Lima, Peru, to defuse tensions over issues like cybersecurity, trade, and Taiwan. Both leaders aimed to smooth over ties before President Trump's upcoming inauguration, amidst U.S.-China strains, China-Russia relations, and economic stakes.

title: Biden and Xi's Pivotal Meeting: Navigating Cross-Pacific Tensions
description: Joe Biden meets Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC forum, aiming to ease tensions with challenges over cyber crime, trade, and Taiwan. As Trump's upcoming inauguration looms, both leaders address concerns including U.S. investment in China. Xi's strategic Latin America visit also underscores geopolitical dynamics.

title: Historic APEC Meeting: Taiwan Invites Biden Amid U.S.-Taiwan Relations
description: At the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, Taiwan's representative Lin Hsin-i met U.S. President Joe Biden, inviting him to visit Taiwan. The meeting, also attended by Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, highlighted ongoing U.S.-Taiwan relations despite China's objections. Secretary of State Antony Blinken emphasized regional cooperation with Taiwan.

title: China Seeks Partnership Over Rivalry with U.S.
description: Amid rising tensions, China aims for a partnership with the U.S., promoting dialogue to reset relations. Beijing dismisses ambitions to surpass America, focusing instead on trade cooperation. Yet, analysts doubt China's influence, especially over Taiwan, remains robust. The Sino-U.S. relationship needs careful diplomatic navigation to avoid conflict.

title: Biden Invited to Taiwan Amid U.S.-Taiwan Relations Dialogues
description: Taiwan's representative, Lin Hsin-i, invited U.S. President Joe Biden to visit Taiwan during an Asia-Pacific summit. Their discussion at the APEC summit was described as lively, with a focus on strengthening U.S.-Taiwan ties. The U.S. remains a crucial ally for Taiwan amidst tensions with China.
